note: Actual shipments confirmed, not merely declared: dated customs records with B/L numbers show this entity as shipper from Indian ports (Sonepat ICD, Raxaul) to Malaysia and Nepal, latest 2026-02-17. IMPORTANT HS DISCREPANCY: declared HS 850760 (lithium-ion accumulators) does NOT appear in any observed record. All five visible rows carry 27101990 (petroleum/lubricating oils), 39199010 and 39199090 (self-adhesive labels/hologram stickers). Per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground — company stays in the database and the HS code should be corrected to the factual codes observed (27101990 / 39199010 / 39199090), verdict accepted_hs_corrected. The claimed industry 'Энергетика' is likewise unsupported by the shipment record, which points to lubricants and security-label trading. Role appears to be trader (buying labels from J. Patton Sports Marketing LLC / Wuho Petroleum Packaging and reselling lubricants), consistent with rule 1 — traders are not rejected. Caveat: only 5 of the claimed 321 rows were visible on the free tier, so the full HS mix cannot be verified; no 850760 row was seen but absence in a 5-row sample is not proof of absence across all 321. Revenue and export volume: null — not public on the accessible pages, not estimated. Slug note: 'assurance-intl-ltd' returned an empty record; only 'assurance-intl-limited' carried data.
